''See also: [[Path of the Endless Sword Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Path]] of the [[Endless Sword]] is a sword-aspect [[Path]] that focuses entirely on offensive capabilities, specifically cutting and destruction. It lacks defensive or protective techniques, as its [[sword aura]] is utilized solely for striking rather than shielding. The [[Path]] relies heavily on [[vital aura]] and is most effective when the practitioner wields a weapon with a sharp edge. A core component of this [[Path]] is the ability to enforce [[madra]] into a weapon so that it continuously gathers aura as it moves, increasing in strength through motion. This characteristic is exemplified by the [[Flowing Sword technique]], which allows a weapon to become more powerful with every thrust and slash. The [[Path]] features several specialized techniques, including the namesake [[Endless Sword]] technique. This ability can manifest as a storm of invisible blades or uncontrolled slashes, capable of shredding opponents or even creating a cage of energy. Advanced applications include the [[Final Sword]] and various [[Rippling Sword]] maneuvers. Practitioners often advance by immersing themselves in combat and facing life-or-death situations on the battlefield. While sword-aspect [[Paths]] are common, the [[Path]] of the [[Endless Sword]] is considered exceptionally powerful when taken to extreme levels. Notable practitioners include the deceased [[Sage of the Endless Sword]] and his disciple, [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]].}}
